claims: Qwen 3.8 dropped nine days ago; six days later a jailbroken version shipped that refused zero of 842 harmful prompts
Technique is 'abliteration': refusal lives in one direction inside the weights; delete it and the model keeps its capabilities
Over 200,000 downloads in a week (on-screen counter 171,878); Alibaba cannot take it back
Creator is pro local models but says an easily-deletable guardrail is not a guardrail
